text: Self weight should keep its share instead of feeding it back into the idea
description: Self weight (loopWeight) means: share of an idea's value delivered by its own work rather than its sub-ideas. Today it is a self-loop in the flow iteration, so the retained share is fed back and raises the idea's value (v = ½(in + l·v)). Example: goal splits evenly into big (passes everything on) and small (self weight 1, one child) — small ends up worth 0.167 vs big 0.125, and sends 1.5× less instead of 2× less to the shared child. Model the retained share as absorbed (kept, not recirculated). Leaf retention is the same mechanism and should be treated consistently.
